player.gold_per_turn: ruleset-aware expected income: city surplus for City, city surplus minus unit upkeep for Mixed, unavailable for Nation until exact building upkeep is projected
player.city_gold_surplus_per_turn: sum of owned-city surplus[O_GOLD], which already reflects the ruleset's city-paid upkeep
player.unit_gold_upkeep: sum of exact own-unit upkeep[O_GOLD], or null when any vector is unavailable
player.gold_upkeep_reserve: immediate exact unit-gold exposure at the next turn boundary
player.gold_upkeep_style: City, Mixed, or Nation from PACKET_GAME_INFO

city.unit_support: home-city grouped exact unit upkeep vectors

player_rates.bounds: rates are integer ten-point increments, sum to 100, and never exceed the common stock-government 60-percent bound

fail_closed: net gold is unavailable when city gold surplus, upkeep style, or required upkeep components are unavailable
Nation-style net gold remains unavailable until exact building upkeep is projected
rate actions are not advertised during Anarchy or a required government selection
rate actions outside the bounded common-government envelope are rejected before transport
home-city actions without an exact owned co-located city identifier are rejected
invariants: a city food deficit and a treasury deficit are grounded from the same immutable snapshot as their legal recovery action
the proxy advertises controls but does not decide whether a sustainability goal is active
the execution gate still requires exact canonical membership immediately before transport
